gloss: supermarket (a self-service grocery store; the full form of the common abbreviation スーパー)

definitions.gloss: supermarket; a self-service grocery store selling a wide range of food and household items
definitions.explanation: A self-service retail store offering a wide selection of food and everyday household goods at competitive prices — the standard term for what English speakers call a supermarket. In Japanese daily life, the abbreviated form スーパー is overwhelmingly more common, but the full スーパーマーケット is used in formal writing, official names, advertising, and academic/business discussion of the retail industry.

examples.japanese: {近所|きんじょ}のスーパーマーケット。
スーパーマーケットで{食料品|しょくりょうひん}を{買|か}う。
examples.english: To buy groceries at a supermarket.

examples.japanese: {駅前|えきまえ}に{大型|おおがた}のスーパーマーケットがオープンした。
examples.english: A large-scale supermarket opened in front of the station.

examples.japanese: {大手|おおて}スーパーマーケット{各社|かくしゃ}は、{物価|ぶっか}{高|だか}に{対応|たいおう}するため{独自|どくじ}のプライベートブランド{商品|しょうひん}の{展開|てんかい}を{強化|きょうか}している。
examples.english: Major supermarket chains are strengthening the rollout of their own private-brand products in response to rising prices.

notes:
スーパーマーケット is the full-length loanword for "supermarket." In conversation, the abbreviated form スーパー is far more common; the full form is reserved for formal contexts.

ABBREVIATION:
- The everyday Japanese word for "supermarket" is the abbreviated スーパー — when speakers say 「スーパーに{行|い}く」 ("I'm going to the supermarket"), they essentially never use the full form.
- The full スーパーマーケット appears in: company names ({地域|ちいき}スーパーマーケット, etc.), formal writing, business journalism, signage in some markets, and discussion of the retail industry as a whole.
- Caution: スーパー by itself can also mean "super" as an English-style prefix ({スーパー}{特急|とっきゅう} "super express") or as casual praise ({すごい} → スーパー "super!"). Context disambiguates.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- スーパーマーケットで{買|か}い{物|もの}をする: to shop at a supermarket
- {大型|おおがた}スーパーマーケット: large-scale supermarket
- {地域|ちいき}スーパーマーケット: regional/local supermarket chain
- スーパーマーケット{業界|ぎょうかい}: the supermarket industry
- {大手|おおて}スーパーマーケット: major supermarket chain
- スーパーマーケットチェーン: supermarket chain

RELATED RETAIL TYPES:
- コンビニ({エンスストア}): convenience store — much smaller, 24-hour, premium prices ({セブン-イレブン}, ローソン, ファミリーマート)
- ドラッグストア: drugstore — pharmacy plus everyday goods; often overlaps with supermarkets in food range
- デパート / {百貨店|ひゃっかてん}: department store — multi-floor, broad merchandise, higher-end
- ホームセンター: home improvement / hardware store
- {商店街|しょうてんがい}: shopping street, traditional small-shop precinct
- ディスカウントストア: discount store
- {道|みち}の{駅|えき}: roadside station / farmer's market

SIMILAR / RELATED TERMS:
- スーパー: "super(market)" — the standard everyday abbreviation
- {市場|いちば}: traditional market (often outdoor or covered), distinct from a modern supermarket
- {食品|しょくひん}スーパー: "food supermarket" — a supermarket primarily selling food (as opposed to a {総合|そうごう}スーパー "general supermarket" that also sells clothing and household goods)
- {総合|そうごう}スーパー: general/comprehensive supermarket (e.g., イオン, イトーヨーカドー), selling food, clothing, and household goods under one roof

USAGE NOTES:
- In daily speech, prefer the abbreviation スーパー; reserve スーパーマーケット for writing or formal contexts.
- The katakana spelling has a long vowel on each ー (スー, パー, マー, ケッ, ト); the standard accent is on the first syllable in some regions, but the word is often pronounced flat.
